edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the _safeMint recipient in mint
msg.sender keys presalePermission and is the mint recipient in earlyMint
presalePermission mapping is indexed by msg.sender
msg.sender-keyed allowance is decremented in earlyMint
block.timestamp seeds the starting index randomness in setStartingIndex
block.timestamp seeds background/skintone/toy randomness in generateNewClub
maxSupply is read in the mint supply require
price is read in the mint payment require
reserved is read in the mint supply require
ifSaleStarted modifier gates mint on saleStarted
mint executes _safeMint which invokes an external receiver callback
IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received callback can reenter mint
mint performs nTokens * price multiplication checked against msg.value
price feeds the multiplication in the mint payment check
nTokens parameter drives the loop bound and price multiplication in mint
preSaleStarted require gates earlyMint
saleStarted must be false for earlyMint to run
presalePermission is checked and consumed in earlyMint
earlyMint executes _safeMint which invokes an external receiver callback
onERC721Received callback can reenter earlyMint before allowance accounting settles
earlyMint subtracts qty from presalePermission
presalePermission storage value is decremented
qty parameter drives loop bound, price multiplication and allowance decrement in earlyMint
withdraw performs payable(owner()).send(balance)
local balance is forwarded to send in withdraw
changePreSaleStartedVariable calls setStartingIndex on first enabling
changePreSaleStartedVariable toggles preSaleStarted
changeSaleStartedVariable toggles saleStarted
setBaseURI writes baseURI
setPrice writes price
setMaxSupply writes maxSupply
claimReserved subtracts number from reserved
reserved state variable is decremented in claimReserved
claimReserved also executes _safeMint external callbacks
onERC721Received callback can reenter claimReserved
wallets array parameter is iterated to set presalePermission
whitelist grants presalePermission of 5 to each wallet
_URI parameter is written to baseURI in setBaseURI
newPrice parameter is written to price
newMaxSupply parameter is written to maxSupply
number parameter bounds the claim loop and reserved subtraction
_receiver parameter receives the reserved _safeMint tokens
local supply snapshot feeds the mint loop token ids
local supply snapshot feeds the earlyMint loop token ids

normalization_plan.reason: nTokens is only consumed by mint where it drives the mint loop and payment multiplication
qty is only consumed by earlyMint for allowance checks, loop bound and payment
wallets array is only used by whitelist to populate presalePermission
newPrice is only written into the price state variable by setPrice
newMaxSupply is only written into maxSupply by setMaxSupply
number only bounds the claimReserved loop and reserved subtraction
_receiver is only used as the mint target inside claimReserved
_URI is only assigned to baseURI inside setBaseURI
supply is a transient totalSupply snapshot used only within the mint loop
supply is a transient totalSupply snapshot used only within the earlyMint loop
balance is the transient contract balance value passed directly to payable(owner()).send
